simple.summary: עָרוֹד (ʻârôwd) means an onager (from his lonesome habits) First listed occurrence: Job 39 5.

definitions.full: H6171. arod עָרוֺד noun [masculine] wild ass (probably Aramaic loanword ( = Hebrew מֶּרֶא ), עֲרוֺדָא עֲרָדָא, ᵑ7 Syriac ; Mandean אראדא , compare Hom NS 133 ); **perhaps √ [ run away ?], < √ schreien [DHM zu Asma'ï, Farq p.43] das auch vom Wildesel vorkommt Amra alqais 4. 21, Zuhair 1. 25.' — Nö Fünf Mo`all, ii. 75 (SB Wlender Akkadian cxlii) . — Job 39:5 .
